content: This information does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. It is not intended to replace individualized medical advice or the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. In Canada, also contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Adding plans enables you to make informed comparisons. The information provided is for general informational and educational purposes only.
